name: HB Specialty Foods
old_description: Our Turnkey Solutions Simplify Your Business. Your focus should be on making the connections that will land your product into YOUR customer’s hands — and here is how HB can help.
about:
HB Specialty Foods operates from its headquarters in Nampa, Idaho, with additional manufacturing facilities in Boise, Idaho; Beloit, Wisconsin; and Cookeville, Tennessee. The company was co-founded by Beau Guthrie, who serves as Co-CEO, and built its foundation on high-performing coating systems including batters, breaders, and coating solutions.

The company provides turnkey solutions for food manufacturers, spanning custom product development, R&D, procurement, co-packing, regulatory compliance, certification, blending, shipping, specialty crop sourcing, contract dry blending, and specialty packaging. Its three manufacturing facilities feature specialty segregated lines to prevent cross-contamination, and the firm manages relationships with over 20,000 acres of growers across the Pacific Northwest for conventional, organic, biodynamic, and regenerative crops.

HB serves food manufacturers and brands seeking to bring cleaner-label, natural, and sustainable products to market faster. Customers include businesses scaling from small-batch production to high-volume runs, as well as companies requiring allergen-controlled environments and regulatory guidance for shelf-ready packaging.

The company positions itself as a partner in the shift toward healthier, more sustainable food, emphasizing flexibility, deep ingredient expertise, and end-to-end supply chain management. Its differentiators include BRCGS-certified facilities, direct farmer connections, and a legacy in coating technology that informs its broader product development capabilities.
